deployment_assumptions: Assume the gate oxide cannot be updated post-manufacture. Physical access for attackers is limited to environmental conditions that may induce degradation over time.
open_questions: What are the maximum operating and environmental conditions expected for this component?
Is there a pre-existing baseline for oxide breakdown rates over typical device lifecycle durations?
prioritization_summary: Prioritize threats based on oxide integrity under stress, fault injection potential, and the likelihood and impact of leakage currents causing device malfunctions.

prioritized_actions.next_step: Validate material choices against stress simulations at design review.
prioritized_actions.rationale: Material selection directly prevents critical breakdown threats that are non-reversible.
prioritized_actions.title: Select Robust Oxide Materials

prioritized_actions.next_step: Incorporate additional design margin studies for gate oxide durability.
prioritized_actions.rationale: High likelihood and significant impact demand immediate design phase attention.

prioritized_actions.rationale: Essential to ensure manufacturing precision and prevent undetected oxide defects.

security_requirements.description: Ensure oxide material selection accounts for maximum operational stress and environmental conditions.
security_requirements.design_robustness: Robust material selection mitigates failure scenarios without needing updates.
security_requirements.priority_rationale: Addressing material integrity is paramount to device reliability, preventing premature failure.
security_requirements.requirement: The design shall select gate oxide materials with verified breakdown voltage exceeding the utmost operational stress by at least 15%.
security_requirements.title: Select Robust Oxide Materials
security_requirements.verification_method: Material testing and simulation under extreme scenarios.

security_requirements.description: Establish stringent manufacturing controls to preserve oxide uniformity and minimize defect introduction.
security_requirements.design_robustness: Proactive defect elimination minimizes risk of leakage rendering post-sale mitigation unnecessary.
security_requirements.priority_rationale: Prevention of defects in early manufacturing stages is critical to uphold oxide function.
security_requirements.requirement: The manufacturing process shall include oxide thickness testing at multiple stages to ensure consistency within 5% tolerance.
security_requirements.title: Manufacturing Process Control
security_requirements.verification_method: In-line thickness measurement and statistical process control.

summary: Assessment of gate oxide for integrity and threat resilience at the oxide, dielectric, and isolation layer.

threats.deployment_consequence: Cannot be repaired post-deployment, permanent device failure possible.
threats.description: Stress or excessive electric fields can cause the gate oxide to break down, leading to loss of functionality.
threats.priority_rationale: High impact that directly influences device reliability and is difficult to mitigate post-deployment.
threats.scenario: Prolonged operation at high temperatures accelerates breakdown.
threats.sdlc_phase_description: During design, the oxide thickness and material selection must ensure resilience to breakdown under specified conditions.
threats.title: Gate Oxide Breakdown

threats.deployment_consequence: Permanently affects device functionality if not addressed pre-deployment.
threats.description: Defects or thinning in the oxide layer can cause leakage currents that alter device states undesirably.
threats.potential_impact: Functional errors due to unintended current paths.
threats.priority_rationale: High impact, especially in devices where electrical isolation is crucial.
threats.scenario: Manufacturing variations cause oxide thinning, increasing leakage.
threats.sdlc_phase_description: Requires precision in fabrication to maintain geometry and thickness of the oxide layer.
threats.title: Leakage Current Induction

threats.deployment_consequence: Challenging to reverse or correct post-deployment without hardware replacement.
threats.description: Charge builds up in the oxide layer, altering threshold voltages and affecting the transistor behavior.
threats.potential_impact: Drifts in device performance, leading to errors in operation.
threats.priority_rationale: While significant, the gradual effect allows some operational compensation techniques.
threats.scenario: Repeated cycling causes charge trap states to build up slowly.
threats.sdlc_phase_description: During pre-silicon testing, environmental stress tests must identify potential for charge trapping.
threats.title: Charge Trapping Effects
